description: Full-text search across r/wallstreetbets DD analyses (separate from /search which only covers news). Powered by Meilisearch, typo-tolerant. Indexes AI title, original Reddit title, tickers, post summary, discussion summary, fact-check claims, and selftext (both languages). Returns titles + tickers only; pass the returned postId to get_dd_post for the full analysis.
